# Collection

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Collection>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An aggregation of resources published or curated as a unit — an anthology, album, gallery, or series bundle. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) whose members ride the universal [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md) spine.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an aggregation of resources curated as a unit — an anthology, album, or gallery at the [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier; its members ride the universal part spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for an ongoing ordered feed (use [`gmeow:DataFeed`](gmeow-DataFeed.md), which subclasses [`Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md)) and avoid minting a membership subproperty — members ride [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md).

### How to use

- Type the aggregate [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md) and attach its members via [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md); an ordered streaming aggregate is the [`gmeow:DataFeed`](gmeow-DataFeed.md) specialization.

### Examples

- ex:anthology a [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md); [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md) ex:story1, ex:story2.
